title: Building Sand Berms Ahead of Storm Season
description:
With a strong El Niño in the forecast this fall and winter, the City's beach mechanized team is installing sand berms on City beaches and the Mission Bay shoreline. 

Crews use large equipment to move and shape sand into berms, which are intended to protect against flooding caused by high tides and surf. The berms are installed annually ahead of the winter storm season, and with strong El Niño conditions predicted this year, emergency officials are urging extra precautions.

While flooding in coastal areas can occur during winter storms, particularly when combined with high tides, anticipated El Niño conditions could increase that risk and affect locations that do not typically experience flooding.

Berm installation is anticipated to take several weeks, starting on the bay and then moving along the beach shoreline to be completed by early November: insidesandiego.org/city-prepares-beaches-and-bay-shoreline-winter-storms
